title: Control file overwriting when moving files
summary: Use flags with mv to force overwriting, ask for confirmation, or prevent overwriting existing files at the destination.

steps.explain: Move a file and force overwrite the target if it exists, without prompting.

placeholders.name: TARGET
placeholders.description: Path to the target file (will be overwritten)

alternatives.explain: Move a file and prompt for confirmation before overwriting an existing target.
Move a file but do not overwrite the target if it already exists.

rollback.explain: If you accidentally overwrote a file, you cannot undo the move directly. You must restore the file from a backup.

warnings: Using --force will permanently overwrite the target file without warning.
There is no built-in undo for mv; ensure you have backups if using --force.
